name: pi-telegram-stt
description: STT orchestrator extension for the Pi coding agent + @llblab/pi-telegram bridge. Wraps the inbound voice/audio pipeline (downloads voice notes, runs STT via a peer-dep provider extension, sends a 🎙️ echo to the user, and feeds the transcript into the agent prompt). STT is delegated to a peer-dep provider extension (default: pi-openai-stt; the only one in the repo since v0.5.0) selected via extensions.pi-telegram-stt.stt_provider in telegram.json. The 🎙️ echo is one feature of this package, not its purpose — the package name is the scope (STT orchestration), not a single feature. v0.7.0: bundled _logger.ts (was shared at extensions/_logger.ts in the source repo; now per-package so this npm package is self-contained and installable via plain `npm install` from the registry).
